# Released storage migration fixtures

These files are immutable raw state/file-backend exports produced by tagged EndlessFS binaries. They are compatibility inputs, not golden outputs generated by current code.

| Fixture | Producer | Source commit | SHA-256 | Covered releases |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pre-aggregate-v0.1.4.json` | v0.1.4 | `edb67f8e345694001b9614604c5baded9bde5d86` | `24111f7739207b53fad5c4e1cf0ca106982b40fce33850f045d7430150260258` | v0.1.0–v0.1.4 |
| `recursive-aggregates-v0.1.7.json` | v0.1.7 | `1548dafa30ea3fbf0340b3b32381e885a110ef5e` | `0e2ce0a0853cba6e29730346b69e3c829240f617b1f277949f394b9a54786a51` | v0.1.5–v0.1.7 |

The tags grouped on one row have identical durable writer and canonical-format source blobs for the represented family. For v0.1.0–v0.1.4, `format.go`, `transfers.go`, and `engine.go` are respectively Git blobs `422e0df8c13fb4e041d7d9065ad9826079d7b541`, `c95e7035d2b72b896e09101e38268a4b1c7d2805`, and `0eea6130ec29c918c22c0f14e83f4c8f28bf9770`. For v0.1.5–v0.1.7 they are `423ae18d348a78181eb250214e90bea17d0ce532`, `f3165e5b04a8b5cf44c3778f9b734e5f3e1ea409`, and `0d023e455d51ec0050c90354ef9a44ad6654faab`. The executable registry and immutable digests live in `release_migration_test.go`.

Do not edit or regenerate an existing fixture. Before a release whose durable writer differs from every registered family:

1. check out the release candidate in a detached worktree;
2. generate representative live, trash, zero-byte, empty-directory, completed-upload, and aborted-upload state using that candidate's public behavior;
3. export raw backend key/body maps without current-code decoding or rewriting;
4. record the tag, commit, and SHA-256 digest here and in the executable registry;
5. prove the prior fixtures fail before adding any required migration;
6. run `nix run .#test-migration -- vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` and `nix flake check`.

Release mappings and fixtures are append-only. Removing one requires the major-version compatibility process in `AGENTS.md` and the normative specification.
